jobs.title: Fleet Operations Coordinator
jobs.description: Fleet Operations Coordinator – Mississauga Garage Coach Canada | Mississauga, ON Coach Canada is seeking a Fleet Operations Coordinator for an upcoming, newly created position at our Mississauga garage. This role will support daily coordination between maintenance and dispatch and serve as a key point of contact for Toronto drivers, supporting bus readiness, timely departures and effective communication across teams. What You Will Do Coordinate daily activities with maintenance and dispatch to support bus readiness for scheduled departures. Act as a main garage point of contact for drivers, providing support with bus assignments, departures and returns. Assist with fleet and driver scheduling to support efficient use of resources. Coordinate maintenance requirements, follow up on repairs and confirm bus release status with the appropriate teams before communicating availability to dispatch. Communicate dispatch instructions, assignment changes and operational updates to drivers. Respond to changing operational needs and communicate delays or concerns promptly. Support established safety, inspection and reporting procedures. Maintain operational records, support shift handovers and complete related administrative duties. Collaborate across departments to support service quality and efficient workflows. Support drivers with day-to-day operational needs and assist with other departmental initiatives as required What You Bring Proven experience in transportation, dispatch, fleet coordination or a related operational environment. A minimum of two years of experience working in a unionized environment. Willingness to work outdoors in varying weather conditions and provide hands-on operational support as needed. A solid understanding of the Canada Labour Code and applicable occupational health and safety requirements. Supervisory experience is considered an asset. Project management skills, with the ability to coordinate tasks and follow through on initiatives. Strong verbal and written communication, organizational and problem-solving skills. Ability to manage changing priorities and work collaboratively across teams. A commitment to safety, accountability and employee support. A diplomatic and professional approach to resolving concerns, managing competing priorities and maintaining positive working relationships. Understanding of electronic Driver Vehicle Inspection Reports (EDVIRs), vehicle maintenance requirements and applicable commercial vehicle safety regulations. Flexibility to support our 24/7 operations, with a work schedule to be determined that may include days, afternoons, nights, weekends and holidays. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals, including those who self-identify as members of the four designated groups under the Employment Equity Act : women, Indigenous peoples, persons with disabilities, and members of visible minorities. In accordance with the Canadian Human Rights Act , the Pay Equity Act , and the Accessible Canada Act , we are committed to treating all applicants fairly and without discrimination. Accommodations are available upon request throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities or other accessibility needs. If you require accommodation at any stage of the hiring process, please contact us to make arrangements that best support your full participation. jobs.title: CLIENT SERVICES & OPERATIONS COORDINATOR
jobs.description: Salary: $50k - 55k per year Reference: JOB-6053 Client Services & Operations Coordinator Location: Toronto, ON Start Date: Immediate Duration: Permanent Work Type: Full-Time Compensation: $50,000–$55,000 annually, with flexibility up to $60,000 for an exceptional candidate Role Overview We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and client-focused Client Services & Operations Coordinator to manage the administrative and logistical coordination of client transitions, from initial booking through to the completion of moves, downsizing projects, and clear-outs. This position requires someone who can confidently manage multiple client files simultaneously, communicate professionally with families and service providers, and ensure all arrangements are addressed in advance. The successful candidate will take ownership of responsibilities, anticipate potential issues, follow through on outstanding matters, and independently manage routine day-to-day decisions. An important part of this role is providing administrative and operational support to the General Manager and management team by managing details, keeping matters organized, and minimizing the need for management involvement in routine activities. Key Responsibilities Client & Move Coordination • Coordinate administrative and logistical details for client moves, downsizing projects, and clear-outs. • Serve as a primary point of contact for clients and their families throughout the transition process. • Coordinate communications between clients, family members, Power of Attorneys (POAs), retirement residences, internal teams, and external service providers. • Confirm move dates, timelines, access requirements, and special client instructions. • Ensure all necessary information, documentation, and arrangements are in place before scheduled service dates. • Secure and confirm elevator bookings for applicable moves and coordinate requirements with retirement residence staff. • Identify potential scheduling or logistical issues and coordinate solutions proactively. • Work with internal departments to ensure all team members have the information needed to complete each project. Client & Family Communications • Maintain professional, timely, and compassionate communication with clients, families, and POAs. • Respond to inquiries, provide updates, and follow up on outstanding questions or requests. • Communicate schedule changes, service requirements, and project updates to relevant parties. • Liaise with retirement residence staff regarding move arrangements, access, elevator reservations, and other requirements. • Build positive working relationships with retirement residences and external service providers. • Ensure clients and families feel informed, supported, and confident throughout their transition. Contracts, Invoicing & Accounts Receivable • Prepare and issue client contracts and service agreements. • Ensure signed contracts are received before moves, clear-outs, or other services begin. • Prepare and issue accurate client invoices in a timely manner. • Monitor outstanding accounts and ensure payments are received within established payment terms. • Follow up professionally with clients and families regarding overdue invoices and outstanding payments. • Maintain accurate records of invoices, payments, and account balances. • Escalate unresolved payment issues or discrepancies to the General Manager. CRM & Administrative Management • Maintain and regularly update the CRM with accurate client information, contact details, contracts, invoices, communications, and project notes. • Ensure client files and records are complete, organized, and up to date. • Maintain accurate scheduling records, service dates, client requirements, and outstanding tasks. • Ensure important information is documented and accessible to appropriate team members. • Develop and maintain consistent administrative processes to support efficient daily operations. • Assist with general administrative duties
